classification.difficultyReason: Determine the required base area and choose three whole-number factor pairs while retaining the fixed height.

content.prompt: A right rectangular prism has volume $240\text{ m}^3$. The height of the prism is $10\text{ m}$. Give three sets of whole number dimensions for such a prism.

answer.short:
Sample answers: $1\text{ m}\times24\text{ m}\times10\text{ m}$; $2\text{ m}\times12\text{ m}\times10\text{ m}$; $4\text{ m}\times6\text{ m}\times10\text{ m}$.

The length and width must multiply to $24\text{ m}^2$, with height $10\text{ m}$.
answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}lw&=\frac{V}{h}\\lw&=\frac{240}{10}\\lw&=24\text{ m}^2\end{align*}$$
Three whole-number factor pairs of $24$ are $(1,24)$, $(2,12)$ and $(4,6)$.

Keeping the height at $10\text{ m}$ gives dimensions:

$1\text{ m}\times24\text{ m}\times10\text{ m}$,

$2\text{ m}\times12\text{ m}\times10\text{ m}$,

$4\text{ m}\times6\text{ m}\times10\text{ m}$.

Each set has volume $240\text{ m}^3$.
